Syllabus_Units.unit_title: Relational Model, ER Diagrams & Schema Design
Syllabus_Units.description: Entity-Relationship modeling, relational algebra, and relational schema optimization.
Complex subqueries, window functions, stored procedures, triggers, and DDL/DML.
Functional dependencies, lossless join decomposition, multi-valued dependencies.
Serializability, two-phase locking (2PL), deadlock prevention, and recovery techniques.
CAP theorem, document stores, key-value engines, sharding, and replication.
